practiceSets.title: A Train Trip to Da Nang
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a family's train journey and answer questions about their travel experience.

passage.title: Our Summer Trip
passage.content: My family loves to travel. Last summer, we went to Da Nang by train. The train journey was long, about 10 hours, but it was fun. We saw green fields and small villages from the window. My brother, Minh, read a book, and I listened to music. My parents talked and looked at the scenery. We ate snacks and drank juice. When we arrived in Da Nang, the weather was sunny and warm. We stayed in a hotel near the beach. Every day, we swam in the sea and built sandcastles. We also visited a big market and bought some souvenirs. The train ride back was also nice. We were tired but happy. We want to go to Da Nang again next year.

practiceSets.title: Staying Healthy Every Day
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about simple daily habits for a healthy life and answer questions about health and body care.

passage.title: My Healthy Habits
passage.content: Staying healthy is important for everyone. I try to follow some simple habits every day. First, I always eat a good breakfast, like eggs and bread, to give my body energy. I also drink a lot of water throughout the day. Water helps my body work well. Second, I exercise for at least 30 minutes. I usually ride my bicycle or go for a walk in the park. Exercise makes my muscles strong and helps me sleep better. Third, I try to get enough sleep, about 7-8 hours every night. Sleep helps my brain rest and makes me feel fresh in the morning. Finally, I wash my hands often, especially before eating, to stop germs. These habits help me feel good and have energy for school and friends.

practiceSets.title: A Day in the Life of a Teacher
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a teacher's daily work routine and answer questions about their job.

passage.title: My Job as a Teacher
passage.content: My name is Linh, and I am an English teacher at a primary school. My job is very important because I help young children learn. Every morning, I wake up at 6:00 AM, have breakfast, and prepare for school. I arrive at school at 7:30 AM. My first class starts at 8:00 AM. I teach English to children aged 6 to 10. We learn new words, sing songs, and play games. The children are always happy and full of energy. During the break, I talk with other teachers and drink coffee. In the afternoon, I teach two more classes. After school, I check homework and plan lessons for the next day. I usually leave school at 5:00 PM. It's a busy job, but I love seeing my students learn and grow.

passage.title: Capturing Moments
passage.content: My name is Hoa, and my favorite hobby is photography. I love taking pictures of everything around me. I have a small digital camera, but sometimes I use my phone camera too. I like to go to the park or the lake on weekends to find beautiful things to photograph. I take pictures of flowers, trees, animals, and sometimes people. I also enjoy taking photos of sunsets and sunrises. After I take the pictures, I often use a simple app on my phone to make them look better. I share my best photos with my friends and family online. They always say my photos are nice. Photography helps me see the world in a special way and remember beautiful moments.

practiceSets.title: Exploring Ho Chi Minh City
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about different aspects of city life in Ho Chi Minh City and answer comprehension questions.

passage.title: My Life in the City
passage.content: I live in Ho Chi Minh City, a very big and busy city in Vietnam. There are many tall buildings, wide streets, and a lot of motorbikes. Life here is fast, but it's also exciting. In the city, you can find everything you need: big shopping malls, small local markets, and many restaurants. My favorite place is District 1, where I can see old French buildings and modern skyscrapers. I often go to Nguyen Hue Walking Street in the evening with my friends. We enjoy the lights and the street performers. Public transport like buses is available, but many people prefer motorbikes. Even though it can be noisy, I love the energy of Ho Chi Minh City. There's always something new to see or do.

practiceSets.title: The Delicious Pho
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about the famous Vietnamese dish, Pho, and answer questions about its ingredients and cultural significance.

passage.title: Vietnam's Famous Noodle Soup
passage.content: Pho is a very famous and delicious noodle soup from Vietnam. It is popular all over the world. People often eat Pho for breakfast, but you can enjoy it any time of the day. There are two main types: Pho Bo (beef noodle soup) and Pho Ga (chicken noodle soup). The soup has a rich, clear broth made from bones and spices like star anise and cinnamon. Inside the bowl, you will find soft rice noodles, thin slices of beef or chicken, and fresh herbs like basil and cilantro. People usually add lime juice, chili, and bean sprouts to their Pho for extra flavor. It's a warm, comforting dish that many Vietnamese people love and feel proud of. It's more than just food; it's a part of our culture.

practiceSets.title: Using My Smartphone Every Day
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about the common uses of a smartphone in daily life and answer questions about basic technology.

passage.title: My Smart Helper
passage.content: My smartphone is a very useful tool in my daily life. I use it for many things every day. First, I use it to communicate with my family and friends. I send text messages, make phone calls, and use social media apps to chat. Second, I use it for information. I can quickly search for news, weather forecasts, or directions to a new place using maps. Third, it helps me with entertainment. I listen to music, watch short videos, and play simple games when I have free time. I also use it to take photos and record videos. My smartphone is like a small computer that fits in my pocket. It helps me stay connected, informed, and entertained wherever I am.

passage.title: Green Space in the City
passage.content: Our city has a beautiful park called Green Lake Park. It's a wonderful place to enjoy nature, even in the middle of the city. The park has many tall trees that provide shade on sunny days. There are colorful flowers everywhere, especially in spring. A small lake is in the center, and you can see ducks swimming peacefully. Many people come to the park to walk, run, or ride bicycles on the paths. Children love to play in the playground. It's also a good place to have a picnic with family and friends. We should always remember to keep the park clean by putting our trash in the bins. Protecting this green space helps us breathe fresh air and feel calm. It’s a gift of nature for everyone.

practiceSets.title: Celebrating Tet in Vietnam
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about the Vietnamese New Year celebration, Tet, and answer questions about its traditions.

passage.title: The Most Important Holiday
passage.content: Tet Nguyen Dan, or Tet, is the most important and biggest holiday in Vietnam. It is the Vietnamese New Year, celebrated at the end of January or early February. Before Tet, families clean and decorate their homes. They buy new clothes and special foods. Red and yellow are popular colors for decorations because they bring good luck. On Tet, families gather together. Children receive 'li xi' (lucky money) in red envelopes from adults. People visit relatives and friends, wishing them good health and happiness. Traditional foods like Banh Chung (sticky rice cake) are eaten. Many people also visit pagodas to pray for a good year. Tet is a time for family, hope, and new beginnings.

practiceSets.title: Learning to Play the Guitar
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about someone's experience learning a new skill, playing the guitar, and answer questions about the learning process.

passage.title: My New Challenge
passage.content: I always wanted to learn to play a musical instrument, so last month I started guitar lessons. Learning a new skill is a challenge, but it's also very rewarding. My teacher, Mr. Nam, is very patient. He teaches me how to hold the guitar, how to place my fingers on the strings, and how to read simple music. At first, my fingers hurt a little, and it was hard to make a clear sound. But I practice every day for about 30 minutes. I watch online videos and try to play simple songs. Slowly, I am getting better. I can now play a few basic chords and a short melody. My goal is to play my favorite songs soon. It takes time and effort, but I enjoy every step of learning.

passage.title: Learning English
passage.content: I am learning English because I want to study abroad in the future. It's a big goal, but I am working hard. I have an English class three times a week. In class, we learn grammar rules, new vocabulary, and practice speaking. My teacher encourages us to speak English as much as possible. Besides class, I also practice at home. I listen to English songs and watch English movies with subtitles. I try to read simple English stories every day. Sometimes, I talk to my friends in English, even if we make mistakes. Making mistakes is okay; it helps me learn. Learning English is not easy, but it is exciting. I believe that with continuous effort, I will achieve my dream.
